name: Entry Hall
summary: Tickets, the wall of makers, and the first look into Tool Hall.
body:
The Entry Hall is a double-height room with the museum's wall of makers: brass nameplates for every living maker who has taught a workshop here.

A desk at the east door answers questions and holds school-group packets. There is no ticket machine on this site; tickets are sold at the desk.
highlights: Wall of makers|Coat check|School desk|Access ramp from River Walk

name: Tool Hall
summary: Hand tools, measuring instruments and the big machines that shaped Rookwater's workshops.
body:
Tool Hall runs the length of the north wing. Cases hold planes, gauges, and a wall of hammers from the Rookwater forge (story).

The center bay has a restored treadle lathe that runs during weekend demos.
highlights: Treadle lathe|Forge hammers|Measuring wall|Loan crate for school kits

name: Textile Wing
summary: Looms, dyes, pattern books and the mill samples from Rookwater's weaving sheds.
body: The Textile Wing is quieter. Light is kept low for the pattern books. A working loom sits by the window for Thursday weaving demos.
highlights: Floor loom|Dye cabinet|Pattern books|Mill sample drawers

name: Ceramic Court
summary: Kilns, molds and the Rookwater stoneware that traveled downriver.
body:
An open court with skylights. The kiln models are cutaways so you can see the shelves inside.

School groups sit on the low wall for clay talks.

name: Workshop Gallery
summary: Temporary exhibitions of living makers: benches, jigs and unfinished work.
body: The Workshop Gallery changes with each temporary show. Benches are bolted down; tools on the walls are real and labeled do-not-touch.
highlights: Changing benches|Tool wall|Maker portraits|Window to Tool Hall

name: Study Vault
summary: Study tables, accession files and the quiet room for researchers and members.
body:
The Study Vault holds accession cards, loan files and a reading table for members. Staff pull objects from storage by request.

Not a public gallery; signed-in members see the packet that explains how to book a table.
highlights: Accession drawers|Reading table|Loan file cabinet|Object request desk
